excluded_from_promotion.csql.err: CUBRID client-side connect log. Inspected before exclusion: it contains only 'Program csql ... connected' NOTIFICATION lines and boot_cl.c:875 CODE=-971 notifications, i.e. one entry per client connection this session opened. No error, no failed statement.
excluded_from_promotion.perf-*.data: raw perf sample files (1.2-2.5 GB each, 4.6 GB total). The derived profile-*-flat.txt / profile-*-callgraph.txt reports and the perf-stat-*.txt counters are promoted and hashed, and every profile number in the report is read from those. The .data files themselves are dispensable work and were DELETED at query completion together with the rest of work/Q19 (SSOT section 19: 'promote required files to raw and delete dispensable work'). They are reproducible from raw/Q19/profile_driver.sh against the pinned binaries.

notes: CUBRID native cannot reach zero physical reads on Q19 and is NOT claimed to: its plan reads the whole lineitem heap+index (>13 GB) against an 8192 MB data_buffer_size, giving 14,313,083 trace ioreads and 14,339,369 /proc syscr per statement. WARM is proved in the steady-state sense (level converged, within-block sd 0.26%, three block medians within 1.43%) and the residual reads are recorded, not hidden. The CONTROLLED PAIR used for F_units and F_cpu (CUBRID orextract, PostgreSQL native) is zero-physical-read on both sides, so I/O residency is confined to F_plan.

cubrid statdump buffer counters again read delta 0 over a whole block on this server (Q14/Q16/Q18 defect, reconfirmed); retained in the headline JSONs but EXCLUDED from every calculation. CUBRID buffer/IO evidence rests on the engine trace and /proc (rchar, syscr) instead, which agree to 0.18%.

The first stage-14.7 pass recorded telemetry_run.py rc=1 for cubrid native and postgresql native: that harness has no '-' sentinel for 'canonical query' and opened '-' as a path. Only the single-statement U cross-check was affected and it was rerun to completion (tel1_repair.sh); the block-regime headline telemetry from the first pass is untouched and is what the card uses.

q19-oneterm.* is an ATTEMPTED control that did not achieve its stated goal and is retained with that status: it aimed to express the extracted restriction as ONE CUBRID term by pushing count_and_or above 100, but CUBRID's range rewriter re-merged the added bounds and the clause still distributed (28 part sargs vs the 27 of q19-orextract). Its measured 0.293 s is reported as a same-engine predicate-FORM probe, not as the F_plan anchor.
